# Code of Conduct

## Be respectful
Treat others with respect. No harassment, insults, or personal attacks.

## Stay on topic
Issues and discussions should relate to DcDNS:
- bugs
- feedback
- documentation
- security notes

## No spam
Do not post ads, malware links, or unrelated content.

## No source abuse
Do not submit modified versions of DcDNS or encourage redistribution of derivatives.

## Enforcement
The maintainer may close issues, lock discussions, or block users who violate these rules.

## Contact
Report problems through GitHub Issues or the official project Discord.
